opening.argument: The presentation invites viewers to join Forsage and contact a supplied number for details, while promoting earnings through multiple slots, tiered circles, and branching participant structures. It says, “You should take 12 slots for 3 slot to get 10x in income,” presenting a stated multiplier tied to participation. It further links earnings to “your 4 Upline, 4 Downline, 4 Downline, and your 4 Crossline,” and describes revenue and a salary arising from placements within the depicted structure. The diagrams show X3, X4, XXX, and XGold tiers with slots, rupee figures, arrows, and percentage claims. Alongside the claim that 200,000 people earned 200 crore rupees in five months, these features present recruitment-based returns dependent on expanding interconnected tiers and circles, rather than an ordinary product or service transaction.
